snippet.title: Mario Kart Wiicompiled + Retro Rewind | Trailer
snippet.description:
The stream trailer that was shown for Mario Kart Wiicompiled, now uploaded as a youtube video!

Download the Wiicomp: https://github.com/TeamWheelWizard/WheelWizard/releases

Credits:
SNES Rainbow Road music by @PanmanMusic.
Mario Kart Wiicompiled developed by @patchzyy.
Trailer filmed and edited by @ZachPL-05.

If you enjoy this video, be sure to subscribe for more content and download Retro Rewind if you are even remotely interested in playing the distribution!

Download Retro Rewind: https://wiki.tockdom.com/wiki/Retro_Rewind
